description: Juniper NetScreen legacy firewall session logs. Handles the structured key=value syslog format including device_id=, action=, src=, dst=, src_port=, dst_port=, proto=. Note: 'src zone=' and 'dst zone=' contain embedded spaces and are captured separately.
sample_log: May  4 09:00:00 ns-fw NetScreen: system-info-00257(session): start_time="2004-11-08 01:30:18" duration=28 policy_id=110 service=ftp proto=6 src zone=Trust dst zone=Untrust action=Permit sent=1940 rcvd=6488 src=10.1.1.1 dst=10.2.2.2 src_port=1254 dst_port=21
